summary: Frontend-only sanity check for the 3 perf fixes (mute-by-default WalkthroughPlayer, deferred demo-audio MP3 fetch, interaction-or-idle third-party analytics defer helper). All 7 requested checks PASSED against the public preview URL. No regressions observed.

test_results.1_landing_loads: PASS - Title 'ORA by Aurem — developers choice'. Only benign React Router v7 future-flag warnings in console; no errors.
test_results.2_walkthrough_muted_by_default: PASS - data-testid='walkthrough-mute' renders with aria-label='Unmute narration', title='Unmute narration', icon 🔇 (muted state) on first render.
test_results.3_no_demo_audio_fetch_while_muted: PASS - 0 requests to /demo-audio/*.mp3 after initial load, and still 0 after scrolling the walkthrough embed into view and waiting ~3s.
test_results.4_unmute_triggers_audio_fetch: PASS - Clicking walkthrough-mute flipped aria-label to 'Mute narration' and immediately fetched /demo-audio/step-1.mp3, then step-2.mp3, then step-3.mp3 as playback progressed. End-to-end audio path intact, just deferred until user opt-in.
test_results.5_visual_playback_controls_intact: PASS - walkthrough-playpause present (count=1), walkthrough-jump-N step dots present (count=7). Player renders/plays normally while muted.
test_results.6_third_party_defer_still_initializes: PASS - After ~5.5s + small mouse move + scroll: window.fbq=function, window.gtag=function, window.dataLayer is Array (len=5), window.__auremDeferThirdParty=function. Meta Pixel + Google Ads gtag both eventually boot as intended.
test_results.7_no_error_dom_elements: PASS - Zero elements matched .error / [class*=error] / [id*=error] on landing.

critical_code_review_comments: Optional nit: on unmute click the audio-sync effect triggered fetches for step-1, step-2, and step-3 within ~4s while only one step is 'active' at a time. That's likely the intended preload-next-step behavior in WalkthroughPlayer, but if further bandwidth savings are desired, gating preload to just the current step (and prefetching next step only after current one starts playing) would drop another ~30KB per user session for users who unmute but bounce quickly.

Below the walkthrough embed there are 3 native <audio controls> elements (visible in the screenshot as the '0:00 / mm:ss' bars) — these are unrelated to the WalkthroughPlayer, but if they also point to /demo-audio/*.mp3 they will still eager-fetch on landing. Out of scope for this round, flagging for a possible follow-up perf pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This round only validated the perf-defer changes on the public landing page's WalkthroughPlayer embed and index.html third-party defer helper. Backend was intentionally not touched or tested. All 3 fixes verified working via live network capture on preview URL.
